name: Haze
description: A short reverb into a soft fuzz into a long reverb: notes lose their attacks, grow overtones and hang as one glowing wall.

params.name: Haze
params.description: How hard the blurred sound is pushed into the fuzz. Higher grows more overtones while the loudness stays where it was.

params.name: Blur
params.description: How much the sound is smeared before the fuzz. Low keeps the attacks and their bite; high lets every note swell in and melt into the next.

params.name: Decay
params.description: How long the wall rings after the playing stops.

params.name: Mix
params.description: Balance between the dry signal and the wall. Fully up is the wall alone.

params.name: Size
params.description: How big the second space is. Small is close and dense; large is open and slower to fill. Moving it bends the pitch of the tail.

params.name: Tone
params.description: Tilts the fuzz before it enters the long reverb, from dark wool at the bottom to bright glare at the top.

params.name: Octave
params.description: Folds the wave over before the fuzz, which adds the octave above. A little gives a glow; fully up the octave takes over from the note.

params.name: Feed
params.description: Sends the wall back through the blur and the fuzz. More makes it thicker and longer; it always dies away in the end.

params.name: Width
params.description: Stereo width of the wall only. Zero is a mono wall; full is the widest.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on cpp/kit: an allpass smear, a level-following waveshaper at four times the sample rate and an eight-line feedback delay network. Not a model of any pedal or plug-in.
